description: This Java source file defines the entity 'LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment' representing an installment in a loan repayment schedule within the Apache Fineract project. It manages various financial components such as principal, interest, fees, penalties, and associated operations like payments, waivers, write-offs, and data copying.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment
classes.description: Represents an installment in the loan repayment schedule, encapsulating details of amounts due, paid, waived, written off, as well as status flags and related entities like charges, post-dated checks, and transaction mappings. Provides methods for payments, refunds, resetting balances, copying data, and comparison.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Interface method for payment functions, accepting date and amount to process payment components.

methods.name: payPenaltyChargesComponent
methods.description: Processes payment towards penalty charges, updating outstanding amounts and tracking total paid in advance/late.

methods.name: payFeeChargesComponent
methods.description: Processes payment towards fee charges component, updating amounts and totals.

methods.name: payInterestComponent
methods.description: Processes interest payment, updating interest paid and related tracking.

methods.name: payPrincipalComponent
methods.description: Records payment against the principal, updating outstanding principal and tracking.

methods.name: waiveInterestComponent
methods.description: Waives interest due, updating waived interest components.

methods.name: waivePenaltyChargesComponent
methods.description: Waives penalty charges and updates relevant components.

methods.name: waiveFeeChargesComponent
methods.description: Waives fee charges and updates related components.

methods.name: writeOffOutstandingPrincipal
methods.description: Writes off the outstanding principal amount, marking it as written off.

methods.name: writeOffOutstandingInterest
methods.description: Writes off the outstanding interest amount.

methods.name: writeOffOutstandingFeeCharges
methods.description: Writes off the outstanding fee charges.

methods.name: writeOffOutstandingPenaltyCharges
methods.description: Writes off the outstanding penalty charges.

methods.name: isOverdueOn
methods.description: Checks if the installment is overdue as of a given date.

methods.name: updateChargePortion
methods.description: Sets the amounts for charges and penalties due, waived, and written off.

methods.name: addToChargePortion
methods.description: Adds amounts to the charge and penalty components.

methods.name: updateAccrualPortion
methods.description: Updates accrued interest, fee, and penalty amounts.

methods.name: updateObligationsMet
methods.description: Updates obligations status based on outstanding amounts.

methods.name: trackAdvanceAndLateTotalsForRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Tracks total paid in advance or late payments for the installment period.

methods.name: isInAdvance
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date is before the due date.

methods.name: isLatePayment
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date is after the due date.

methods.name: checkIfRepaymentPeriodObligationsAreMet
methods.description: Validates if all obligations for the period are met based on total outstanding.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the principal amount as Money object.

methods.name: getInterestCharged
methods.description: Returns the interest charged as Money.

methods.name: getFeeChargesCharged
methods.description: Returns total fee charges as Money.

methods.name: getPenaltyChargesCharged
methods.description: Returns total penalty charges as Money.

methods.name: resetBalances
methods.description: Resets all derived balance components.

methods.name: copyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from a period or another installment, resetting and then copying properties.

methods.name: updateLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Updates and retains matching loan compounding details.

methods.name: updateLoaInstallmentCharges
methods.description: Updates and retains matching installment charges.

methods.name: updatePostDatedChecks
methods.description: Updates and retains matching post-dated checks.

methods.name: updateTransactionRepaymentScheduleMapping
methods.description: Updates and retains matching transaction to schedule mappings.
